item_name: Rothco Compact Weekender Backpack With Cross
item_short_desc: Rothco's Vintage Weekender Backpack is a must-have for anyone looking to bring their essentials away for the weekend. The Weekender Backpack allows you to fit everything you need between its roomy interior and multiple pockets.
description: Rothco's Vintage Weekender Backpack is a must-have for anyone looking to bring their essentials away for the weekend. The Weekender Backpack allows you to fit everything you need between its roomy interior and multiple pockets.   This backpack  is made using washed-out canvas and features 2 front inside pockets with drawstring closure, an inner zipper pouch, 2 side pockets with flaps, and side pockets with strap closures with metal buckles. All of the bag’s buckles, snaps, and grommets are antique brass, giving the bag its vintage washed-out look. The bag has a roomy interior with a drawstring closure and adjustable shoulder straps, making it comfortable and practical.
